description: Finds data scientists and ML engineers to recruit using apidojo's Twitter scrapers on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: find data scientists on Twitter for recruiting, discover machine learning engineers or AI researchers to hire from X, find data analysts or ML practitioners by specialization on Twitter, identify NLP computer vision or LLM engineers via social signals, find data science professionals open to work on Twitter, build a data science talent pipeline from social, or find researchers posting about job opportunities. Returns handle, name, ML specialty (from bio/tweets), stack (Python/R/TensorFlow), follower count, and open-to-work signals. Ideal for ML engineering hiring managers, AI research labs, and data-driven startups.
